name: Tidewave (nshafer)
description: Installs the Tidewave CLI when the image builds, and starts it at each container start, so the Tidewave app on your host can work with the project in the container.

version.description: The version to install: 'latest', or an exact X.Y.Z that matches a tidewave_app release tag.

port.description: The port that the CLI listens on in the container. Publish the same port number on the host, with "appPort": ["127.0.0.1:9000:9000"]. The CLI refuses a request whose Origin names another port.

allowRemoteAccess.description: Listen on every address in the container, not on 127.0.0.1 only. A published port needs this, because Docker sends it to the bridge address of the container. The CLI still refuses a request whose Origin is not localhost.

debug.description: Write what the CLI does to /tmp/tidewave.log. Off by default, because a healthy run is silent.

autostart.description: Start the CLI at each container start. Turn it off to install the program only, and run 'tidewave' yourself.
